name: Poznachos
description: Tortilla chips underneath the whole thing, eaten fast.
longDescription: Corn tortilla chips on the bottom, vegan beans and/or sour cream, then pozole, toppings, and salsas piled on top, so the chips start softening the second it's in your hands. Built to be eaten fast and messy, this is the one that doesn't wait for you.

variants.label: Poznachos Plate
variants.note: Corn tortilla chips topped with pozole, vegan beans and/or sour cream, toppings, and salsas.
